text:
nina: Following up on the token validation postmortem. Short recap: expired service token was re-used + a logging emitter outage caused missing audit rows. We need concrete owners, short mitigations, and a recurring prevention plan.
omar: I'll take ownership of audit detection & dashboards. Will add a panel showing token_validation gaps and emitter restarts correlated by minute. ETA: Tue.
jen: I'll handle secrets rotation verification and runbook updates. Need exact secret names and the KMS key alias.
infra-bot: Created issue SEC-2026-1299 in tracker. Please assign subtasks.
nina: Quick mitigations: 1) block reuse of expired tokens in the validation service for 24h, 2) temporary alert on audit gap > 1m, 3) force immediate rotation for the affected service. Who picks which?
omar: I'll build the gap alert and dashboard. Query I'm going to use: ```sql
SELECT service, count(*) FROM audit_logs
WHERE event='token_validation' AND success IS NULL AND ts >= now() - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY service;
```
jen: I'll do the rotate+verify for ingress-proxy tonight at 23:30 UTC with on-call present. Checklist: generate key, update secret ingress/proxy, rolling restart, smoke validate, verify audit entries. I'll paste runbook link after completion.
secops-bot: Note: add compliance tag and evidence upload to SEC-2026-1299.
nina: Owners/deadlines: omar - audit+alert (due 2026-04-06), jen - rotate+runbook (due 2026-04-05), nina - postmortem doc + trends analysis (due 2026-04-08). infra-bot, create subtasks.
infra-bot: Subtasks created: 1299-A audit-alert (owner:omar, due:2026-04-06), 1299-B rotate-verify (owner:jen, due:2026-04-05), 1299-C postmortem-trends (owner:nina, due:2026-04-08).
omar: I'll add a rolling 7d metric: audit_emitter_gap_rate{service="ingress-proxy"}. Alert -> page if >0 for 10m. PR incoming.
jen: Staging rotation done, smoke passed. Planning prod rotation tonight 23:30 UTC. Using this curl for verification: ```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" https://auth.redwood.example/v1/validate | jq .status
```
nina: Good. Also let's add a weekly scheduled job that validates current tokens across services after any secret change. Make it visible in the deploy playbook.
omar: Will add the weekly smoke job and a grafana panel tying emitter restarts to missing rows.
jen: Prod rotation scheduled. I'll post runbook and tracker evidence when complete.
secops-bot: Reminder: upload rotation evidence (logs + smoke output) to SEC-2026-1299 before closing.
nina: OK reconvene next Mon to review evidence and close subtasks. If anyone sees >0 audit gaps after rotation, escalate immediately. Thanks. :thumbsup:
